title: Superstar
description: Superstar, the superstar look, is a face built for covers: beauty key, catchlights, a flash wall or crowd implied, wardrobe that photographs as money. Fame is a fact in the lighting, and the room is already looking.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Arrivals, stages, a character who wins by being seen. Hold the eyeline.
Do not dirty the frame unless the fame is collapsing. Glamour is in the setup, not added later as a grade.
A spy in a basement does not want this. It is the wrong tool when attention is theft rather than consent.
That sidewalk glare is 2000s paparazzi. If nobody in the world of the shot would stop walking, you did not shoot a superstar.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height, 85mm or 50mm, lock-off. Beauty key with a large source, catchlights, a little diffusion, optional kicker.
Flash wall or crowd implied in highlights, not as readable letters. Wardrobe that reads as money.
Prompt: Superstar treatment of [Subject], paparazzi bloom, flash wall, a face built for covers.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Superstar in film?
A fame recipe: beauty key, catchlights, implied flash wall, a face the room is already looking at. The camera is usually locked. The light is consent, not theft.
Superstar vs 2000s Paparazzi
Superstar is sanctioned cover light. 2000s paparazzi is on-camera flash, compact digital, a face not ready. If the shadow on the wall is ugly and accidental, you wanted the cousin.
When should I use Superstar?
Arrivals, stages, a character who wins by being seen. Skip spies, basements, and hunted sidewalks.
How do I prompt Superstar for AI image or video?
85mm, beauty key, catchlights, then: Superstar treatment of [Subject], paparazzi bloom, flash wall, a face built for covers. Hold eyeline. Do not dirty the frame.
